name: enterprise-ai-copilot
description: Enterprise AI Copilot SDK monorepo — embeddable page-aware assistant for business web apps

scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --prefix packages/sdk && mkdir -p apps/demo-host/public/vendor && cp packages/sdk/dist/enterprise-copilot.js apps/demo-host/public/vendor/enterprise-copilot.js
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --prefix apps/demo-host
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm run test:gateway
scripts.verify: npm run lint:sdk && npm run test:sdk && npm run build:sdk && npm run test:gateway
